title: Arkret Presence Visibility Account Data
description: Closed decrypted plaintext shape for the principal-private ak.presence.visibility account-data value. The sending client applies this policy before encrypted Signal fanout; services MUST NOT require its plaintext or project it into server-readable policy state.

presence_visibility.description: Closed sender-side policy. public permits effective-scope fanout, contacts_only requires every other active member to be an accepted Contact with current holder-to-peer presence scope, consent_only requires a fresh complete exact-peer complete Consent current with an eligible presence entry for every other active member, and nobody suppresses sends. No receiver-side filtering substitutes for whole-scope confidentiality.
